title: Outstanding Guide
text:
We had an excellent experience visiting Pilate’s House with Isabel as our guide. She is extremely knowledgeable, passionate about her work, and it shows in every part of the tour. Her explanations were detailed, engaging, and easy to understand, bringing the history and architecture of this beautiful place to life.

Beyond the tour itself, she was happy to share recommendations for other attractions, restaurants, and places to visit in the area.

title: This sight is worth a visit and Isabel is a great guide
text: We had a wonderful visit to Casa de Pilotes with Isabel. She was very communicative prior to the day of our tour and met us promptly at the designated time. She was very knowledgeable and clear and was able to answer all of our questions. I highly recommend a visit to this wonderful house and any tour with Isabel.
author: V8937BLdanas

title: Excellent experience
text: Our guide Isabel was great. Very knowledgeable and friendly.  She took her time to give us extra recommendations of other places to see in Seville
author: 146ibrahimp

title: Beautiful site & great Tour Guide
text: Isabele was my Tour Guide and she was amazing. She gave an interesting background. Isabele is fluent in English and really nice. She gave me lots of sightseeing tips. She even gave me a lovely gift of a local sweet pastry.
author: Tina_P

title: What a wonderful afternoon
text: What a wonderful afternoon I spent with Isabel during my private tour of Pilates’ house&garden!!! Isabel was so emphatic and charming, like I met a relative from another country! I really appreciate her knowledge and  dedication and I learned so many new things about Andalusian style, the explanation of the name Pilates, or Catalina de Rivera….I feel like I have to come back!
author: BeatriceS223

title: Worth the Visit WITH Guide
text: We really liked the visit. The guide is very patient and kind. He has told us everything he could about the house: its history, its construction and applications and the art it contains.
author: Cointa R

title: Pilates House Tour with Isabel R.
text: Isabel was a wonderful tour guide! We spent the morning with her seeing the Pilates House and the Bullring. Her knowledge of both was amazing! Don’t miss going to the Pilates House! I would highly recommend her!!
